answer: Sybil resistance tightens when identity is expensive to fake at verification time. Each new agent posts a bond and must keep a public mirror of its graded work. Every epoch, peers crack a random walnut of that history against a fresh challenge; a mismatch slashes the bond and freezes payouts. A rotating opal capability, earned only after several consistent matches, is what actually unlocks emission. A farm can still spin names, but each fake voice needs a funded bond and must survive sampling, so attacker cost scales with the swarm, not with sign-up forms.
